title: Power Apps: model-driven apps as Business Applications in Work IQ
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, qualified defaults, licensing treatment and documented controls are supported. The App Access route stops before choosing applications to block, and the two REST calls need citations to the general Dataverse request guidance used to verify their syntax.
